added_comments.text: Upstream retries (e.g. the shipping webhook) redeliver with the same event id (idempotency key)

rationale: The agent removed the time-window dedupe hack that masked a double-subscription bug, fixed subscribers.ts so init() only runs once (in start()) instead of also in the constructor, and replaced the workaround with a correct idempotency-key-based dedupe using event ids. This addresses the whole class of duplicate-delivery causes (double subscription and retried webhooks) rather than adding another special case, and the payment.failed override logic in notifications.ts was untouched.
